capabilities: Run local learning sessions with retell prompts
Record corrected understanding gaps and migration exercises
Keep observer reflections and next-step learning goals
disambiguation: Not an AI plugin: the Obsidian part only stores prompts and learning records locally, while the AI workflow runs in an external agent via its Skill.
extras: The repository's core product is an Agent Skill; the Obsidian plugin is optional. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. PRIVACY.md is referenced for the no-network, no-telemetry claims.
motivation: The author sees the gap not in summary quality but in what happens after knowledge enters: without reconstruction, error-correction, transfer, and feedback, it never becomes ability.
problem: Summaries and highlights leave knowledge unexamined: gaps in understanding are never corrected, and what you read never gets applied to real tasks or fed back into the next study step.

requires.name: an AI agent that supports Skills

summary: Learning practice system that turns reading into retelling, critique, and real-task transfer, with an optional Obsidian plugin for local session records.
